name: 81521 · Fruita, CO
findings: ZIP 81521 (Fruita) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81521 (Fruita) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 81521 (Fruita) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).
